name: RunPod Media
description: Generate images from text, edit images, animate to video, and generate video from text — all via RunPod public AI endpoints. Supports P-Image, Google Nano Banana, WAN, Kling, Sora 2, Seedance, InfiniteTalk and more.
author: ItamarCoh3n

required.description: Cloudflare R2 Access Key ID — used to upload local images as temporary presigned URLs (1 min) before passing to RunPod. Create an R2 API token at dash.cloudflare.com > R2 > Manage API Tokens.
Cloudflare R2 Secret Access Key — paired with accessKeyId above.
R2 bucket name to use for temporary uploads (e.g. 'openclaw').
